card.name: Glucose tolerance and OGTT terms
card.fires_on: The word tolerance (or its parts, like T-olerance, intolerance, or the OGTT abbreviation) right after glucose, in lab-test or side-effect wording about glucose handling.

modes.label: Tolerance after glucose
modes.description: The word tolerance or intolerance directly follows glucose in warnings or test names.

modes.label: Split heading or abbreviation
modes.description: The pole fires on the later piece of a split Glucose Tolerance heading or the OGTT abbreviation.
modes.example: Glucose T<<olerance>> A worsening of glucose tolerance has been observed

card.plain: It fires when the text is finishing the phrase glucose tolerance, as in a glucose tolerance test or a warning about worse glucose tolerance.
